title: READ@W11 | LEARN@W11
intro: READ@W11 and LEARN@W11 are literacy and tuition programs for children in the community. We also organise regular workshops and family day events.

programs.name: READ@W11
programs.description: READ@W11 is a literacy programme that supports children aged 4 to 9 years old who are facing literacy challenges. The programme offers a phonics-based curriculum, building their confidence and skill in reading the alphabet and simple words. Teachers engage students through games, storytelling sessions, songs and craft.

programs.name: LEARN@W11
programs.description: LEARN@W11 is a tuition and supervised learning programme for children aged 10 to 12 years old. LEARN@W11 offers academic support to primary school students in mathematics and English.
